message.content:
The scene where **Del Boy falls through the bar flap** is in **“Yuppy Love”**, the **first episode of Series 6** of *Only Fools and Horses*.[2][1]

If you meant the clip specifically, it is the famous moment where Del leans back at a wine bar and falls through the open section behind him.[1][2]
